title: Notes
description: Hub notes and personal notes: Blocks or Classic editor, smart links to hubs, files, authors, and clubs.
content:
Kahana has two note surfaces. Hub notes travel with the pack you share. Personal notes stay yours across hubs.

Primary action: Open Notes

Hub notes

Inside a hub you own or collaborate on, add notes for intros, reading guides, and curriculum. Members of that hub see them with the files.

In Settings → Notes you can pick Blocks or Classic (TinyMCE) as the hub notes editor.

Personal notes

Open kahana.io/notes for notes that are not tied to one hub listing. These are not a public blog.

Smart links

Insert or open links to a hub, file, author, or club from a note. That is how a reading guide points at the real artifact.

Limits

  • Listed hub notes are part of what people with access can read.
  • Personal notes do not appear on Library.
  • Notes generally do not count toward the counted-upload quota. Files still do.

What’s next

  • Adding files and embeds
  • Hubs
  • Saving and collections
